t6_symbolic_plan.rationale: ALREADY INSTALLED at ^4.16.0 in mcp-server/package.json line 71 (Round-2 finding stale). z3-solver is the WebAssembly port of Microsoft's Z3 SMT solver (MIT license), supports SAT/SMT/LP/MIP via Optimize API. Native bundle ~12MB but already in node_modules — sunk cost. javascript-lp-solver (~80KB) considered as lightweight alternative but lacks SMT (theory of integers + reals + bitvectors), which Spec rows 11 (Z3 x ToleranceStack), 28 (geometric tolerance allocation) require. glpk.js (~3MB) is LP/MIP only — insufficient for non-linear tolerance Σt_i² constraints.
t6_symbolic_plan.license_check: MIT — compatible with PROPRIETARY license declared in package.json

wire_targets.solves: Spec row 11 — minimize Σ cost(t_i) subject to Σ t_i² <= T_assembly² (worst-case), or Σ t_i² <= T_assembly²/k (RSS)
wire_targets.z3_idiom: Optimize() context with Real('t_i') variables, add_soft for cost objective, add for sum-of-squares constraint

wire_targets.solves: Spec row 12 — argmax Σ(margin_i * accept_i) s.t. Σ(hours_i * accept_i) <= capacity, accept_i in {0,1}
wire_targets.z3_idiom: Optimize() with Int('accept_i') variables in [0,1], maximize() on margin sum

wire_targets.solves: Spec row 28 — GD&T datum-feature constraint propagation
wire_targets.z3_idiom: BitVec for datum frames + Real for tolerance zones
